name: clauseway/hero-scan
title: Hero scan (contract being read and flagged)
description: A contract page that gets scanned: a beam sweeps down, clauses are flagged as it passes and comment cards appear on drawn lines. Loops every 10 seconds.

clauses.default:
Services | Provider will perform the services described in each Statement of Work that both parties agree to. | none
Limitation of liability | Provider's total liability for any claim under this Agreement will not exceed the fees paid by Customer in the twelve months before the claim. | high
Indemnification | Customer will defend and hold harmless Provider against all claims arising from Customer's use of the services or breach of this Agreement. | high
Term and termination | This Agreement runs for one year. Provider may end it for convenience on thirty days' written notice. | med
Governing law | This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York. | none

cards.default:
Low liability cap | The cap is low and may not cover your losses. Ask for a higher cap, or none.
Broad indemnity | You cover Provider for a wide range of claims. Narrow the scope.
One-sided exit | Only Provider can end this early. Ask for the same right.
